1.
Prayer is for grant of anticipatory bail in case having FIR No.126 dated 15.02.2019 registered under Sections 406, 420, 120-B IPC at Police Station Sadar, District Gurugram.
2. Counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner has joined investigation with the police multiple times on the basis of previous order of interim bail passed by this Court.

sentences.text: The Counsel appearing on behalf of the complainant has not opposed the aforesaid assertions made by counsel for the petitioner.

4. State counsel on instructions from SI Kashmir Singh has not refuted the aforesaid assertions made by counsel for the petitioner and submits that the petitioner is not required by police for further investigation or for custodial interrogation.
5. In view of the above, without commenting on the merits of the case, the present petition is hereby allowed and order dated 23.02.2023 is hereby made absolute.

The petitioner should abide by the conditions envisaged under Section 438(2) Cr.P.C.
 ( KARAMJIT SINGH)
